About the event

Beyond the classroom

Camaraderie Days is the Senior High School Department’s yearly celebration of sports, recreation, and friendship at Sacred Heart School - Hijas de Jesus. For three days, we leave our books for a while, step onto the field, the court, and the pool, and get to know one another beyond the classroom.

Meet the Houses

Caritas

Love and charity · Red

Caritas leads with heart and shows up for everyone.

Spes

Hope · Blue

Spes keeps moving forward with a positive spirit, even when the odds look tough.

Fides

Faith · Yellow

Fides believes and succeeds, no matter what.

Purpose

Camaraderie Days helps us grow as people and students. Through sports and recreation, we live out this school year’s theme of Filiation and Fraternity by practicing teamwork, discipline, and respect.

Significance

When we cheer for our House, support a teammate, or compete on the field, we see that everyone has a gift to share. Sports and recreation help us grow alongside our academic work and strengthen our relationships with our Kapwa Hijas-Hearters.

Objectives

  • Cultivate the synodal spirit by appreciating the talents and skills students and teachers share in each activity.
  • Foster unity and collaboration by developing skills through moderate to vigorous physical activities.
  • Promote camaraderie and mutual respect through healthy relationships and sportsmanship throughout the three-day event.
  • Inspire hope and personal growth by helping participants recognize potential career opportunities in sports and dance.

“Whether you wear red, blue, or yellow, in the end, we are one Hijas Family.”

The memories, experiences, and friends we make along the way are the real trophy. Show up for each other and for yourself. Every cheer, high five, and shared moment makes our school stronger.

Announcements

Event reminders

Check where to meet, what to wear, and what to pack each day.

Every day

  • Know your venue and arrive on time.
  • Bring a water bottle, sunscreen, snacks, money, and your school ID.
  • Pack the attire and equipment for your sport.
  • Wear your House color for identification and bring your team’s signature bandana or accessory.
  • Play safely, avoid rough play, and cheer for your teammates!
Day 1 · TuesdayBatch shirt and jeans

6:45 AM attendance at Fr. Herranz Hall, Sacred Heart School - Hijas de Jesus. This is the meeting base, bag drop, and score display area.

  • Badminton: Racket, appropriate shorts, and PE shirt or extra House-colored shirt.
  • Table tennis: Table tennis racket and PE uniform or extra House-colored shirt.
Day 2 · WednesdayPE uniform

Morning · Cebu City Sports Complex

6:30 AM attendance at the Athletics Oval and Field. Stay with your buddy throughout the visit and avoid loitering around the complex. Bring an extra T-shirt.

  • Swimming: Rash guard, swim cap, goggles, and knee-length cycling shorts.
  • Running: PE shirt with preferred pants or appropriate shorts.
  • Frisbee: PE uniform.

Afternoon · School campus

11:30 AM–1:15 PM is the lunch and travel window. Arrive back at school on time.

  • Badminton: Racket, appropriate shorts, and PE shirt or extra House-colored shirt.
  • Table tennis: Table tennis racket and PE uniform or extra House-colored shirt.
  • Pickleball: Paddle and PE uniform or extra House-colored shirt.
Day 3 · ThursdayBatch shirt and PE pants

7:00 AM attendance at Alumni Hall. Fr. Herranz Hall is the meeting base, bag drop, and score display area.

  • Volleyball: Knee pads, appropriate shorts, and batch shirt or extra House-colored shirt.
  • Pickleball: Paddle and PE uniform or extra House-colored shirt.

12:30 PM afternoon show preparation: Put on your costume, rehearse, and get ready for the show.
